title: Kelowna Wine Tour by E-Bike with Tastings, Lunch & Okanagan Views
includes: Downloadable app with route and navigation
Helmet, bike lock and phone mount
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Participants must be able to ride a bicycle unassisted.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Kelowna, Canada's first UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, on this unforgettable self-guided e-bike adventure through the heart of the Okanagan Valley.

Cycle past picturesque orchards, rolling vineyards, lakes, and breathtaking countryside while enjoying the region's renowned food and wine culture. Visit Hidden Vines Winery and SpearHead Winery for premium wine tastings before finishing at Meadow Vista Honey Wines, where you'll savour award-winning honey wines (meads) and a delicious farm-to-table lunch made with fresh local ingredients. 

Your premium e-bike makes the ride effortless, while our GPS navigation app guides you every step of the way. Includes e-bike, helmet, bike bag, lock, phone mount, and everything you need for an unforgettable day exploring one of Canada's premier culinary destinations. 

Relax, ride at your own pace, and discover the authentic flavours, landscapes, and warm hospitality that make the Okanagan one of Canada's most celebrated wine regions.
